title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 16605 East Avenue of the Fountains in Fountain Hills, Arizona, as the "Dr. C.T. Wright Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 16605 East Avenue of the Fountains in Fountain Hills, Arizona, as the Dr. C.T. Wright Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Names a post office building in Fountain Hills, Arizona, after Dr. C.T. Wright.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 16605 East Avenue of the Fountains in Fountain Hills, Arizona, as the Dr. C.T. Wright Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates, what services it provides, or what customers pay.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation applies from that date.
